primaryQuery: australia public transport fares 2026 (opal / myki / go card / smartrider)
accuracyFlags: Sydney Mon-Thu cap shown as $19 AUD; Transport for NSW lists adult Opal Mon-Thu cap $19.30 (from 14 Jul 2025). Recheck the 2026-27 Opal schedule too: page claims 'checked 12 August 2026' but figure matches no official tier.

Melbourne section says contactless is not accepted on most services so a Myki is required, while the FAQ says several cities 'now accept a contactless bank card directly': internally contradictory and the FAQ never names which. Perth (SmartRider/contactless), Brisbane/SEQ and Sydney do accept contactless; Perth is also free on Sundays (omitted).
Perth SmartRider standard journey $2.80 and DayRider $7.00: DayRider $7.00 confirmed (cut 1 Jan 2026); the $2.80 single-journey figure could not be verified against transperth.wa.gov.au.

Victoria $5.70 full-fare daily cap is correct but temporary (half-price 1 Jun 2026 to 1 Jan 2027, excludes SkyBus, ferries, some regional buses); page must state the end date and what reverts to ($11.40).

Queensland 50c fare: now permanent (legislated 2026), page calls it 'Queensland Translink journey' and 'confirm temporary fare periods' which implies it may lapse; Airtrain and long-distance QR excluded correctly. 'Adelaide metroCARD' as the current Adelaide card is unverified.
